identity.rule_kind: descriptive coverage and stratum rules; not acceptance thresholds, not estimator floors, not perceptual claims
identity.frozen_for: issue #21 audit of the repeat-qualified 96-case development corpus
identity.freeze_note: Thresholds below are fixed a priori from contract and arithmetic facts (float32 samples, 44100 Hz, 176400-sample clip, unit full scale). They are not inferred from, tuned against, or revised after any corpus outcome. Any later change preserves the old report and records a new rule identity and reason.
identity.change_policy: A new rules document with a new identity value supersedes this one; reports record the exact rules_sha256 they were computed under; old reports are never rewritten.

denominator.expected_identities: global-0 .. global-95 (global sound indices 0-95, all partition=development)
denominator.holdout_rule: identities 96-127 are holdout; any holdout identity is refused before any payload access and no holdout file is read

required_inputs: first-run receipt (#19) passing the landed tools/audit_development_corpus.audit_receipt against its raw store
repeat receipt (#20) passing the landed tools/audit_development_corpus.audit_receipt against its raw store
byte-identical corpus index documents across both stores
per-identity metadata bytes and audio bytes byte-equal across both stores
rules document (this file) matching the rules_sha256 recorded in the report
audited_corpus.refusal_rule: if any required input fails, the qualified-corpus audit is refused; diagnostics are retained and no coverage verdicts are emitted; missing store directories are never created

status_vocabulary.partition_rule: for every family and every one of the 96 identities exactly one row exists with a value or null plus a status and reason; per-family status counts reconcile to 96; overlapping descriptive strata across families are explicitly non-additive
status_vocabulary.score_rule: no distribution, average, or aggregate score is computed or called correctness; verdicts are per-row and per-stratum counts only

method.name: direct-arithmetic-fsum-v1
method.arithmetic: float32 little-endian decode; binary64 math.fsum accumulation; no alignment, onset search, trimming, padding, resampling, level normalization, filtering, or gain fitting
method.observation_window: the original full clip, samples 0..176399; time origin is sample 0 at 0.0 s; time_seconds = sample_index / 44100.0

required_inputs: audio.f32le bytes hash-bound through the per-case artifact reference
audio_facts.applicability_rule: applicable to every complete qualified case

finite_sample_count.definition: count of samples finite under IEEE-754; required to equal 176400

exact_silence.definition: true iff every sample is numerically zero (value == 0.0, either sign of zero)
exact_silence.note: signed-zero bytes are reported as stored and are never canonicalized; exact silence is a raw observable, separate from any pitch or energy property

signed_zero_sample_count.definition: count of samples whose stored byte pattern is negative zero (0x80000000)

peak_abs.tie_rule: the first (lowest) sample index attaining the maximum wins

peak_signed.definition: the signed value at the winning peak index

beyond_full_scale_count.note: reaching exactly +1.0 or -1.0 is not proof of a clipping operation

near_silence.justification: 1e-6 native amplitude sits one order of magnitude above the float32 relative resolution at unit scale (~1.19e-7), so sub-threshold signals are at or below single-precision storage noise; the 1e-4 peak condition excludes signals whose RMS is tiny only because excursions are isolated. This is a descriptive convention fixed before data access; it is not an estimator floor, a silence guarantee, or a perceptual inaudibility claim. Full-scale reference if displayed in dB: dBFS = 20*log10(x/1.0).
near_silence.boundary_note: a case with rms exactly 1e-6 or peak exactly 1e-4 is NOT near-silence (strict comparisons)

unavailable_reasons.missing: audio bytes referenced by a complete case are absent or fail their recorded hash
unavailable_reasons.error: samples are nonfinite or the byte count is not 705600

method.name: producer-seam-recording-v1
method.arithmetic: read-only comparison of recorded producer observations; derived values are labeled derived
method.units: gain: 1; peaks: native amplitude, full scale = 1.0

required_inputs: per-attempt worker receipt observations.pre_normalization_peak and observations.normalization_gain_derived from the digest-verified run envelope in the store
normalization_seam.allowed_preparation: none; the final peak alone is never used to reconstruct the earlier peak or gain and never proves bypass
normalization_seam.applicability_rule: applicable only where both recorded seam values exist; a requested-but-missing promised capture is an input defect (error), not an optional omission

classification.active: recorded pre_normalization_peak > 1.0 (strict; contract normalizes only above 1.0)
classification.not_applied: recorded pre_normalization_peak <= 1.0; a pre-peak of exactly 1.0 is the unchanged tie and is not_applied
classification.missing: either recorded seam value is absent; never inferred from the final peak

consistency.gain_definition: recorded normalization_gain_derived must equal exactly (1.0 / pre_normalization_peak) when pre_peak > 1.0, else exactly 1.0 (same IEEE-754 operation as the producer; exact binary64 equality)
consistency.metadata_binding: metadata audio.normalization_gain must equal the envelope normalization_gain_derived exactly
consistency.derived_pre_peak: when active, 1.0 / recorded gain is reported as derived_pre_peak and labeled derived

unavailable_reasons.missing: envelope attempt receipt carries no observations block or lacks a seam field
unavailable_reasons.error: recorded values are inconsistent under the declared exact-equality checks

method.name: inventory-keyed-fixed-bins-v1
method.arithmetic: read the producer-recorded normalized_by_name and physical_by_name maps; bin normalized values into fixed bins declared here
method.units: normalized: 1 on [0.0, 1.0]; physical: the unit declared per name in spec/reference/parameter-inventory-v1.json

parameter_strata.allowed_preparation: none; the pinned inventory is the only conversion reference and no second parameter-conversion renderer is used
parameter_strata.applicability_rule: applicable to every complete qualified case whose metadata maps contain exactly the 78 canonical names

bins.inclusivity: lower edge inclusive, upper edge exclusive, except the final bin whose upper edge 1.0 is inclusive
bins.additivity: within one parameter the four bins partition the 96 cases and are additive; strata across different parameters or families are non-additive and are never summed

intended_controls.rule: keyboard.midi_f0, keyboard.duration, LFO frequency/weight settings, vco tunings, mixer weights, and mod-matrix depths are intended parameter settings (controls), never measured mixed-output frequencies, measured source contributions, or observed selector modes; vco_2.shape and LFO weights are continuous and are never reduced to invented integer enums; raw values and identities are preserved through the per-case artifact digests

dominant_weight_stratum.definition: per LFO, the physical weight with the greatest value among sin, saw, rsaw, sqr, tri, reported only as an intended-control stratum
dominant_weight_stratum.tie_rule: ties resolve to the lexicographically first weight name (rsaw < saw < sin < sqr < tri)
dominant_weight_stratum.non_measurement_note: this is never an observed spectral or source contribution

unavailable_reasons.missing: a parameter name is absent from a metadata map
unavailable_reasons.error: a metadata map carries an unknown or duplicated name, or a nonfinite value

method.name: landed-qualification-scope-check-v1
method.arithmetic: compare the landed qualification scope of every landed pitch/periodic estimator against each case's capture inventory; no estimator is executed

required_inputs: per-case capture inventory from artifact metadata
pitch_stability.applicability_rule: the landed periodic qualification (sim/qualification/periodic-v1.json, scope analytic-development-only) covers declared stationary analytic/isolated models with alias provenance, cycle/sample, waveform, amplitude and residual restrictions; it is not a general mixed-Voice F0 detector. Corpus rows are mixed Voice output captured audio-only, so no landed qualified method applies and no pitch value is estimated for any case
pitch_stability.status_rule: every row is unqualified with the scope reason; a known keyboard.midi_f0 setting is never ground truth for a mixed/FM/noisy/aliased output; unresolved or unsupported pitch is never reported as no pitch; exact silence is a separate audio_facts observable and is not a pitch result

unavailable_reasons.unqualified: landed periodic qualification scope is analytic-development-only (sim/qualification/periodic-v1.json): declared stationary analytic/isolated models with alias provenance, cycle/sample, waveform, amplitude and residual restrictions; it is not a general mixed-Voice F0 detector, and isolated-input estimator domains do not intersect the audio-only mixed-Voice corpus captures

method.name: capture-inventory-check-v1
method.arithmetic: compare required captures (identified post-VCA/weighted pre-normalization source signals and the actual mixer relationship) against each case's capture inventory; no contribution is derived

required_inputs: per-case capture inventory from artifact metadata
noise_contribution_observed.applicability_rule: observed noise energy at the mix requires captured, identified source contributions; mixer.noise knob settings, a noise seed/slot, an enabled route, or a nonzero envelope setting do not establish observed noise energy; the corpus was rendered audio-only (richer_module_facts unavailable, reason audio-only-adapter) so no case has the required captures
noise_contribution_observed.status_rule: every row is missing with the capture reason; the mixer.noise normalized/physical setting is reported only as an intended control under parameter_strata; source powers are never assumed to add to mix power (cross terms); derived weighted quantities are never confused with captured traces; planned directed trace IDs are intentions, not measurements

unavailable_reasons.missing: no captured pre-mix source signals exist for this case (audio-only corpus)

method.name: capture-inventory-check-v1
method.arithmetic: compare required captures (identified stage-boundary evidence such as ADSR output traces) against each case's capture inventory; no stage length is estimated from final audio

required_inputs: per-case capture inventory from artifact metadata
requested physical envelope settings from metadata physical_by_name
envelope_stages_observed.applicability_rule: observed attack/decay/release stage lengths require stage evidence; requested ADSR times and note duration are settings, not observed stage lengths: source truncation, merged stages, zero-release behavior, low excitation and finite observation can make observed lengths different or unidentifiable; the landed direct-envelope/tone/broadband/route methods are qualified on isolated inputs (sim/qualification/envelope-routes-v1.json, constructed development only), not on mixed Voice output
envelope_stages_observed.status_rule: requested physical settings are reported per case as measured settings; the observed-stage-length property is missing for every case with the capture reason; requested and observed values are never mixed

unavailable_reasons.missing: no captured envelope stage evidence exists for this case (audio-only corpus)

method.name: landed-qualification-scope-check-v1
method.arithmetic: compare the landed spectral-analysis qualification scope against each case's capture inventory; no spectrum is computed

required_inputs: per-case capture inventory from artifact metadata
frequency_ranges_observed.applicability_rule: no landed qualified spectral method covers arbitrary mixed Voice output (the landed spectral apparatus is isolated-input; no sim/qualification spectral record covers mixed Voice), so no frequency-range value is computed for any case; the peak_abs peak-time facts in audio_facts are waveform facts, not frequency facts
frequency_ranges_observed.status_rule: every row is unqualified with the scope reason; a keyboard.midi_f0 or vco tuning setting is never an observed output frequency

unavailable_reasons.unqualified: no landed qualified method covers mixed Voice audio
